title: Tabby has 5,500 users and about $100,000 in recurring revenue
teaser: Ali, a former accountant, is building Tabby around a simple idea: small businesses should not have to operate accounting software to get their books done. The startup uses AI to process documents, pull current account data through Plaid and produce a live view of a company’s finances. That puts Tabby in direct competition with QuickBooks, while also making its modest early revenue and ambitious automation goal hard to ignore.
